# Chaduna — Cafe & Wine Bar + Coworking Space, Tbilisi

Chaduna is a cozy cafe, wine bar, and coworking space in Tbilisi, Georgia, located in the historic old city near Liberty Square. Known for syrniki (cottage cheese pancakes), bruschettas, all-day breakfast, 60+ Georgian and international wines, and an authentic Georgian wine tasting experience.

> For comprehensive FAQ, full menu details, and booking information see: https://chaduna.com/llms-full.txt

## Cafe & Wine Bar
- Address: 18 Galaktion Tabidze Street, Tbilisi, Georgia 0108
- Phone: +995 557 629 229
- Hours: Tuesday–Sunday 09:00–23:00 | Monday 09:00–15:00
- Price range: ₾₾ (moderate)
- Payment: Cash and card accepted
- Known for: syrniki, bruschettas, chizhi bizhi – Georgian egg dish similar to shakshuka, all-day breakfast
- Wine: 60+ Georgian and international wines, by glass and bottle; also Chacha
- Dine-in and takeout available
- Pet-friendly (dogs welcome)
- Laptop-friendly; free Wi-Fi
- Nearest metro: Liberty Square / Tavisupleba
- Reserve: https://chaduna.com/reserve.html

## Georgian Wine Tasting
- Price: 70 GEL per person
- Duration: 1.5–2 hours
- Group size: minimum 2 guests
- Advance booking required: Yes: https://chaduna.com/reserve.html

## .hub Coworking Space
- Address: 18 Galaktion Tabidze Street (same building as cafe)
- Hours: Daily 10:00–20:00
- Day pass: 30 GEL | Weekly: 100 GEL | Monthly: 300 GEL
- Includes: high-speed Wi-Fi, cafe access, two free drinks, 20% discount at Chaduna cafe
- Audience: digital nomads, remote workers, freelancers, entrepreneurs, students
